title: WorkPulse candidate.rejected v1
description: HR rejected a candidate from a pre-hire stage. Identifiers, the observed source stage and the acting user only — the rejection note is PII and never leaves the database (`.ai/security.md`).

candidate_id.description: The rejected candidate application (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012 — candidate fallback).

job_id.description: The job the candidate applied to (UUIDv7 string).

rejected_from.description: Stage the candidate was rejected from.

rejected_by.description: Actor user id that rejected the candidate (ADR 0010).
